entities.name: Pakubuwono XIII

entities.summary: Sri Susuhunan Pakubuwono XIII, born as Gusti Raden Mas Suryadi, later changed to Gusti Raden Mas Surya Pratana, and elevated to KGPH Hangabehi, was the twelfth Sunan of the Surakarta Sunanate from 2004 to 2025.
